name: Junior Research Fellowship
benefit: > The fellowship amount for the JRF program is ₹31,000 per month for the first two years and ₹35,000 per month for the remaining three years.
_eligibility_text:
1. Applicant must be Indian citizen. 
1. Applicant must have a master's degree in biotechnology or a related field from a recognized university
1. Applicant must clear the GAT or NET exam in biotechnology or a related field
1. Applicant should not be more then 28 years for general and EWS category candidates and 33 years for SC/ST/PH category candidates
1. Applicant must be willing to pursue full-time doctoral research in biotechnology or a related field at a recognized university or research institution in India.
